item_verdicts.goal: the census now folds neighbouring-cell roots of one physical saddle into one representative: _NULL_MERGE_PITCH_FRACTION = 0.10 is defined once at nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py:853 with the mechanism in its comment, _representative_merge_radius returns 0.10 * source_pitch + 256 * eps * source_pitch (forward_operator.py:1227-1230) and is used for the seed dedup at :1293 and the reduced read at :1554, while the polished-dedup path adds the same pitch term to the root uncertainty at :1356; the summed-radius merge criterion is unchanged, and the exact-mode 132-cell analytic read retains 1 of 3 roots (cluster receipt: active radius 0.0151453873 m, summed 0.0302907746 m, all three pairwise distances 0.0197660917 to 0.0276815232 m below it) with the representative 0.0131400199 m from the closed-form reference x-point.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the run directory: 23 keys, status complete, four commits, the commit bodies carrying no attribution and no plan or sprint identifier; eleven changed_paths, per-gate log paths, negative_control_log the bare path whose first line is the declared string, baseline_suite at d0a714f2 and after_suite at 3408567b both exit 0 with empty failure_ids, and evidence_inputs naming the implementation commit a1f4717e, the delivery tip 357c38d32 and both sbatch job identities.
item_verdicts.write_paths: all eleven changed paths sit inside the six declared write paths; the source diff hunks fall at forward_operator.py 848-856, 1219-1230, 1280-1293, 1341-1356 and 1540-1555, clear of the support clip-mode default and its consumers (106-131 and 3200-3560); no plan-version or plan-modified meta line is touched, the plan edit is the appended landing paragraph and its figure alone, and no concurrent node path is touched; the declared mutation was applied in a scratch copy (roundoff-tree), so the fence admitted it without an excursion and the worktree itself never carried the mutation.

justifications.durability: four commits land in dependency order with conventional subjects and bodies (fix 05:07, cluster receipt 05:11, parity receipt 05:13, landing record 05:30), the receipts are committed as JSON beside their figures with the per-row comparison retained, the landing paragraph and the cumulative evidence section are in the final commit, nine gate logs sit in the fenced report directory with revision, tree and command headers, and the manifest carries four commit shas, eleven changed paths, both suite arms and the negative control. The deduction is that the CANCELLED step is documented rather than attributed and the artifacts field mixes two entry shapes.
justifications.evidence: the load-bearing claims were reproduced from the artefacts rather than read: sacct shows both jobs COMPLETED 0:0 with exit 0, the focused log carries the three ladder rows at source, the suite tails read 190 and 192 passed with zero FAILED lines, the parity receipt aggregates to 0 of 13068 differing cells and 0 of 444 differing wall nodes over 12 rows with empty validation_errors, the cluster receipt keeps both merge verdicts per pair (the plain uncertainty sum 3.04e-13 m does not merge; the active radius does, and the receipt shows why the fold needs the pitch term), and the negative control's first line is the declared string verbatim with one failure, the new regression, at EXIT_STATUS=1. The deductions are the scheduler anomaly and one record-shape slip: step 1276216.0 is recorded CANCELLED 0:15 at the job's own elapsed time with the cause unestablished, carried under follow_ons rather than explained, and the manifest artifacts list mixes metric dicts with bare path strings.
justifications.fit: mechanism-named throughout: _NULL_MERGE_PITCH_FRACTION and _representative_merge_radius carry no plan, sprint or version label, and the comment states the admitted positional error rather than the plan that measured it; the change is 69 insertions over two files, reuses the summed-radius merge rather than adding a second rule, keeps the support clip-mode default and its consumers untouched, places both cases in the existing admission test file beside the analytic_carrier fixture, and reruns the committed topology_parity_harness.py unmodified, with the receipts beside their figures under the existing nova.media-styled convention.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the delivered design is the one the plan fixes and it is met exactly: the discretisation term is the ladder-comparable fraction of the source pitch, named once with the mechanism in its comment, the roundoff radius is kept as the base on the seed path, the existing summed-radius criterion carries the merge, and the two new tests pin both the fold and the distinctness direction; the closed-form reference is the stronger of the two available anchors and the landing record explicitly corrects the earlier trip-arm receipt's read-derived reference rather than inheriting it, which is why no deduction is taken here.
justifications.scope_discipline: the fence held exactly: eleven changed paths all inside the six declared write paths, the source hunks clear of the support clip-mode block and its consumers, the plan edit confined to the appended landing paragraph and figure with the meta lines untouched, only report-directory artefacts outside the repository, and the declared mutation confined to a scratch copy so even the control cost no out-of-fence write.
